summary: American Water Works filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary New Jersey American Water received NJBPU approval on September 9, 2026 of a stipulated general rate case settlement entered August 27, 2026 with NJBPU staff and the Rate Counsel. The order approves a $68 million annualized revenue increase effective September 15, 2026, versus a requested $145 million, based on a 9.5% authorized ROE, $6.06 billion rate base, 54.0% common equity ratio and 46.0% long-term debt ratio, supported by $1.4 billion of incremental capital investment since the prior case. No securities transaction, M&A, or special-situation event is involved; this is ordinary regulatory rate-case activity. Watch for bill-credit and PFAS-related customer impacts.
